title: Table for Two
summary_vi: Bạn sẽ luyện cách gọi món, hỏi đồ uống và thanh toán ở nhà hàng.
sentences: Linh and her brother Minh went to a small restaurant in Hanoi.
The waiter showed them to a table by the window.
"Are you ready to order?" he asked with a smile.
Linh wanted something light, so she chose a vegetable soup.
Minh was very hungry, so he ordered grilled chicken with rice.
"Would you like anything to drink?" the waiter asked.
They both asked for iced tea, and the waiter wrote it down.
The food arrived quickly, and everything tasted delicious.
After the meal, Minh asked for the bill and left a small tip.

vocabulary.example: The waiter brought us two glasses of water.
I would like to order the fish, please.
My sister eats a vegetable at every meal.
I am hungry because I skipped breakfast.
Your homemade cake is delicious.
Can we have the bill, please?
In some countries, you must leave a tip.

questions.explanation_vi: Minh rất đói nên gọi gà nướng với cơm.

options: He paid the bill and left a tip
He took photos of the food
questions.explanation_vi: Minh xin hóa đơn và để lại một ít tiền boa.

title: Room Key Please
summary_vi: Bạn sẽ luyện cách làm thủ tục nhận phòng khách sạn qua một tin nhắn gửi bạn.
sentences: Hi Anna, I arrived in Da Lat this afternoon!
The hotel is lovely, and it is only five minutes from the market.
At the front desk, a friendly woman checked my reservation.
She asked for my passport and gave me a room key.
My room is on the third floor, and it has a big window.
Breakfast is included, and it starts at seven o'clock.
I asked about the Wi-Fi, and she wrote the password on a card.
Tomorrow I am going to visit the flower gardens.
The weather is cooler than in Saigon, so I need my jacket.
Write back soon and tell me about your trip!

vocabulary.example: Please leave your key at the front desk.
I have a reservation for two nights.
Don't forget your passport at the airport.
The lift stops on every floor.
Dinner is included in the price.
I forgot the password for my email.
Take a jacket because it may rain.

questions.explanation_vi: Người viết vừa đến Đà Lạt chiều nay.

questions.question: What did the woman at the front desk ask for?
questions.explanation_vi: Cô ấy yêu cầu xem hộ chiếu.

questions.question: Is breakfast free?
questions.explanation_vi: Bữa sáng đã được bao gồm trong giá phòng.

questions.question: What is the writer going to do tomorrow?
questions.explanation_vi: Ngày mai người viết sẽ đi thăm vườn hoa.

title: Feeling Under the Weather
summary_vi: Bạn sẽ luyện cách mô tả triệu chứng và hiểu lời dặn của bác sĩ qua một trang nhật ký.
sentences: Dear diary, today I felt terrible, so I visited the doctor.
I had a sore throat and a headache since Monday.
The doctor asked me some questions and checked my temperature.
"You have a fever, but it is not serious," she said.
She told me to rest at home and drink lots of water.
I also got some medicine from the pharmacy next door.
I should take it twice a day after meals.
The doctor said I should not go to school for two days.
I feel a little better now, so I am going to sleep early.

vocabulary.example: Hot tea helps when you have a sore throat.
Loud music gives me a headache.
The nurse took my temperature this morning.
The little boy has a high fever.
You should rest after the long trip.
Take this medicine after lunch.
The pharmacy closes at nine o'clock.

questions.question: Which problem did the writer have?
options: A sore throat and a headache
questions.explanation_vi: Người viết bị đau họng và đau đầu.

questions.question: What did the doctor say about the fever?
questions.explanation_vi: Bác sĩ nói sốt không nghiêm trọng.

questions.question: Where did the writer buy the medicine?
questions.explanation_vi: Thuốc mua ở hiệu thuốc bên cạnh.

questions.question: How long should the writer stay away from school?
questions.explanation_vi: Bác sĩ dặn nghỉ học hai ngày.

title: Friends Forever
summary_vi: Bạn sẽ luyện cách giới thiệu và miêu tả người bạn thân nhất của mình.
sentences: My best friend is called Tuan, and we met ten years ago.
We lived on the same street in Saigon.
Tuan is taller than me, and he is much funnier.
He always makes me laugh, even on bad days.
We both love football, so we play every Saturday morning.
Last month, I lost my phone, and Tuan helped me look for it.
He is also a very good listener.
When I have a problem, he gives me honest advice.
I am lucky to have a friend like him.

vocabulary.example: My best friend lives next door.
This film is funnier than the last one.
We laugh a lot when we are together.
A good teacher is also a good listener.

title: Bus Number 18
summary_vi: Bạn sẽ luyện từ vựng và câu hỏi khi đi xe buýt trong thành phố.
sentences: Emma was visiting Saigon, and she wanted to see the zoo.
A local girl told her to take bus number 18.
Emma walked to the bus stop and waited for ten minutes.
The bus was crowded, but a young man gave her his seat.
She bought a ticket from the driver for seven thousand dong.
The ride was slower than a taxi, but it was much cheaper.
Emma watched the busy streets and the motorbikes through the window.
"Which stop is the zoo?" she asked the driver.
He smiled and said, "The next one. I will tell you."
Emma got off the bus and thanked him.

vocabulary.example: The bus stop is near my school.
The market is crowded on weekends.
Is this seat free?
I lost my ticket on the way home.
The driver stopped for an old man.
Rice is cheaper in the countryside.
We got off the train at Hue.

options: To tell her the right stop
questions.explanation_vi: Tài xế hứa sẽ báo cho cô biết trạm cần xuống.

title: Surprise!
summary_vi: Bạn sẽ luyện kể lại một bữa tiệc sinh nhật bất ngờ bằng thì quá khứ đơn.
sentences: Linh's birthday was on Saturday, but she thought everyone forgot.
Her friends planned a surprise party at Minh's house.
Minh told Linh that he needed help with his homework.
When she arrived, the lights were off, and the house was quiet.
Suddenly, everyone jumped out and shouted, "Surprise!"
Linh was so shocked that she almost dropped her bag.
Her friends decorated the room with balloons and colourful paper.
Tuan brought a big chocolate cake with twenty candles.
Linh made a wish and blew out all the candles.
It was the best birthday she ever had.

vocabulary.example: The gift was a big surprise.
We are having a party on Friday night.
He looked shocked when he heard the news.
She decorated the cake with strawberries.
The children love the red balloons.
Please light the candles on the cake.
Close your eyes and make a wish.

questions.question: What did Linh think on her birthday?

questions.explanation_vi: Minh nói dối là cần giúp làm bài tập.

questions.question: How did Linh feel when everyone shouted?
questions.explanation_vi: Linh sốc đến mức suýt làm rơi túi.

title: My First Coffee Shift
summary_vi: Bạn sẽ luyện cách kể về công việc làm thêm đầu tiên và cảm xúc của mình.
sentences: Last summer, I got my first part-time job at a café in Hanoi.
I worked there three afternoons a week.
At first, I was nervous, and I made many mistakes.
I forgot orders, and once I spilled coffee on a customer.
My manager, Mr. Hung, was patient and kind.
He showed me how to use the coffee machine.
After a month, I felt more confident.
I earned a small salary, and I saved half of it.
I learned to manage my time and talk to people.
Now I want to work there again next summer.

vocabulary.example: She has a part-time job at a bookshop.
I feel nervous before every exam.
The customer wants a bigger size.
Our manager starts work at eight.

My brother gets his salary on the first day of the month.

title: Pho From Scratch
summary_vi: Bạn sẽ luyện nghe và làm theo các bước nấu phở tại nhà bằng tiếng Anh.
sentences: Today I am going to show you how to cook pho at home.
First, boil beef bones in a big pot for ten minutes.
Then wash the bones and add fresh water.
Put in an onion, some ginger and a few spices.
Let the soup cook slowly for at least four hours.
While you wait, slice the beef very thin.
Cook the rice noodles in hot water for one minute.
Put the noodles in a bowl and add the raw beef.
Pour the hot broth over everything, and the beef will cook.
Finally, add fresh herbs and a little lime juice.

vocabulary.example: Please boil the eggs for eight minutes.

My grandmother grows herbs in small pots.
